title: CANS Confluence citation-cache schemas
description: JSON Schema for the four Confluence-mirror state layers (01c §2.1, §2.3, §3.1). Each layer has one owner: per-item sidecars + .manifest.json are authoritative cache state; per-space {SPACE}.json is the space roster + treeHash; _index.json is DERIVED/regenerable (gitignored). Mirrors jira/manifest.schema.json, adapted for Confluence. Validate any layer by referencing the matching $def, e.g. { "$ref": "manifest.schema.json#/$defs/itemSidecar" }.

statusSync.description: Local cache state relative to remote. Named status_sync so it never collides with any Confluence content status (01c §2.1).

contentType.description: Mirrored Confluence content type. Maps to a confluence/ subfolder: page→pages/, blogpost→blogposts/. Attachments are tracked under attachments/.

itemSidecar.description: Per-item {SPACE}-{pageId}.json sidecar for pages/blogposts — the authoritative per-item cache state (01c §2.1). The human body lives in the sibling .md; this file carries structured metadata + the dual hashes + the two-timestamp fields.

spaceKey.description: Owning space key, e.g. SEC or PCON.

ancestors.description: Ordered ancestor pageIds (root → immediate parent), for local tree reconstruction (01c §2.1).

remoteLastModified.description: Confluence lastModified as returned by the MCP tools — an opaque display string (format varies: relative or absolute), compared only for exact equality, never parsed. null until first pull.

contentHash.description: Hash of the .md body as last written by ingest/sync — the last-pulled body (01c §2.2).

localEditsHash.description: Hash of the .md body as it currently sits on disk. Differs from contentHash ⇒ human hand-edit ⇒ never clobber (01c §2.2).

lastSyncedAt.description: When this sidecar's body was last written by a REAL remote pull. null until first pull. reindex must NOT touch it (01c §3.1 two-timestamp invariant).

commentsPulled.description: Whether inline/footer comments were cached alongside the body on the last pull (config.pullComments).

sourceRef.description: Relative path to the cached .md body, e.g. confluence/pages/SEC-2097876103.md.

spaceManifest.description: Per-space manifest confluence/spaces/{SPACE}.json (01c §2.3): the space roster + treeHash for cheap per-space structural change detection. Points at each cached item's sidecar.

name.description: Human-facing space name, e.g. CITB Solution — Entity onboarding.

treeHash.description: Hash of the sorted (pageId, remoteLastModified, ancestors) roster — detects a remote page add/remove/move/update on space sync (01c §2.3).

lastSyncedAt.description: Last real pull for this space. null until first pull; reindex must never touch it.

items.description: Space roster. Authoritative for the space subtree; mirrored (derived) into _index.json.tree.

domainManifest.description: confluence/.manifest.json — authoritative cache scope + per-item pointers (committed, low-churn) (01c §2). items is keyed by {SPACE}-{pageId}; empty at fresh init: { "items": {}, "version": 1 }.

version.description: Manifest format version. 1 at fresh init.

spaces.description: Space keys in scope, kept in sync with confluence-sync.config.yml spaces block.

items.description: One entry per cached item, keyed by {SPACE}-{pageId} — the pointer + a copy of the sync-critical fields for a cheap scope read (full state is in the sidecar). Empty object at fresh init.

index.description: confluence/_index.json — DERIVED, regenerable rollup the confluence-search agent loads (01c §3.1). GITIGNORED. Never hand-authored; rebuilt from sidecars + space manifests on every sync and by the offline reindex. generatedAt = last rebuild; lastSyncedAt = last remote pull (reindex must NOT touch lastSyncedAt — §3.1 invariant).

generatedAt.description: Last reindex/rebuild time. Set on EVERY reindex.

lastSyncedAt.description: Last real remote pull time across the mirror. null at fresh init until the first pull (§3.1 timestamp invariant); reindex must never touch it.

items.description: One-line summaries the agent answers most prompts from, drilling into a .md only for full detail (01c §3.1).

tree.description: space key → { name, roots[] } / pageId → children[]. Derived from per-space manifests.

orphans.description: Keys present in manifest but absent from remote, pending disposition.
